stories.title: Attacco a Kharkiv: 3 morti, 25 feriti.Trump: tregua sui siti energetici, Zelensky: "Non ne so nulla"

en.title: Attack on Kharkiv: 3 dead, 25 wounded. Trump: ceasefire on energy sites, Zelensky: "I know nothing about it"
en.summary: An attack on Kharkiv resulted in casualties. Trump announced a ceasefire regarding energy infrastructure, but Zelensky stated he was uninformed. Ukraine reported Russia continues attacking its electrical networks, while reports indicate disagreement over the proposal's terms.

stories.title: Copernicus, il secondo settembre più caldo mai registrato: superati livelli preindustriali

en.title: Copernicus: September second warmest month on record, exceeding pre-industrial levels
en.summary: September ranked as the second hottest month ever recorded, surpassing pre-industrial temperature levels by 1.5 degrees Celsius. El Niño conditions are strengthening in the equatorial Pacific.

stories.title: L'attacco Houthi all'aeroporto di Riad, il video

en.title: Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, video
en.summary: Security cameras captured an explosion at King Khalid Airport in Riyadh, resulting in at least one death and eleven injuries.

stories.title: Almeno un morto e 11 feriti nel nuovo attacco all'aeroporto di Riad

en.title: At least one dead and 11 wounded in new attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: An attack on Riyadh airport caused one fatality and eleven injuries, along with material damage still being assessed.

stories.title: La sfida di Zelensky a Trump: “Elezioni se Putin si ferma”. Giallo sulla tregua energetica

en.title: Zelensky's challenge to Trump: "Elections if Putin stops". Mystery over energy truce
en.summary: Trump announced a ceasefire on energy targets while Russia remained silent. Ukraine's leader stated he had no knowledge of this and reported a Russian attack on a refinery.

stories.title: Guerra in Iran, le news di oggi. A Riad un morto e 11 feriti dopo l’attacco all’aeroporto

en.title: War in Iran, today's news. One dead and 11 wounded in Riyadh after airport attack
en.summary: Trump suggested the possibility of joining attacks against the Houthis and indicated he would speak with bin Salman about the matter.

stories.title: Trump: “Tregua energetica”, ma Mosca smentisce. Sospeso il viaggio in Russia di Witkoff e Kushner

en.title: Trump: "Energy truce", but Moscow denies. Witkoff and Kushner's Russia trip suspended
en.summary: Trump announced an energy ceasefire, but the Ukrainian president stated he was uninformed and accused Russia of striking a power plant following the announcement. Moscow has not confirmed the agreement.

stories.title: Ucraina, Trump punta sulla tregua energetica per abbassare il prezzo del gasolio

en.title: Ukraine: Trump targets energy truce to lower diesel prices
en.summary: Witkoff and Kushner reportedly offered Moscow incentives to halt attacks on Kyiv's electrical and heating infrastructure. The initiative comes amid considerations related to American midterm elections.

stories.title: Zelensky, Mosca ha colpito centrale elettrica dopo annuncio Trump su tregua

en.title: Zelensky, Moscow struck power plant after Trump's announcement on truce
en.summary: Russia attacked a power station in Kyiv using a Shahed drone following Trump's announcement regarding an energy ceasefire.

stories.title: Houthi rivendicano ondata di raid su aeroporto di Riad e impianti energetici sauditi

en.title: Houthis claim wave of raids on Riyadh airport and Saudi energy facilities
en.summary: The Houthis claimed responsibility for a series of attacks on Riyadh's airport and Saudi Arabian energy infrastructure in a new statement.

stories.title: «Ho un nodulo al polmone», l'annuncio di Papa Leone XIV durante l'Angelus gela Piazza San Pietro

en.title: "I Have a Lung Nodule," Pope Leo XIV's Announcement During Angelus Stuns St. Peter's Square
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV announced during the Angelus that he has a lung nodule and will undergo surgery in the coming days. The Pontiff stated the nodule was detected in an early and well-localized phase.

stories.title: Riad, l'attacco degli Houthi devasta l’aeroporto: passeggeri in fuga tra fumo e detriti

en.title: Riyadh, Houthi attack devastates airport: passengers flee amid smoke and debris
en.summary: A missile strike on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh resulted in 12 deaths and 309 injuries. The Saudi-led coalition attributed the attack to Yemen's Houthis, though they have not formally claimed responsibility. The airport suspended operations following the incident.

stories.title: Fibra ottica, l’odissea delle attivazioni: la rete c’è, ma gli utenti restano al palo

en.title: Fiber optic activation ordeal: the network exists, but users remain stranded
en.summary: Fiber optic infrastructure is deployed in various locations, yet customers requesting faster and more stable connections for streaming and work face delays in service activation.

stories.title: Liguria, la Regione rafforza gli investimenti sugli Its

en.title: Liguria, the Region strengthens investments in its technical institutes
en.summary: The Liguria region allocated 6.73 million euros to technical institutes and 6.34 million euros to support employment for people with disabilities.

stories.title: La milanese Medisolve rileva l’austriaca Mides

en.title: Milan-based Medisolve acquires Austrian Mides
en.summary: Medisolve, a Milan-based company backed by private equity firm HIG Capital and a European leader in biomedical equipment management and maintenance services, has acquired Mides.

stories.title: Caccia ai talenti dell’AI: quanto costano e quanto rendono alle imprese italiane

en.title: Hunting for AI talent: costs and returns for Italian companies
en.summary: Italian companies specializing in artificial intelligence are willing to pay significantly more for personnel compared to similar companies, seeking young talent with AI expertise.

stories.title: Ex Ilva: «Stop per l’ordine dei giudici e perché siamo senza materie prime»

en.title: Ex Ilva: "Stoppage due to court order and lack of raw materials"
en.summary: The company cited unrealistic conditions imposed by magistrates within 90 days and stated it halted purchasing for production due to anticipated plant closure.
